title: cymbopogon hirtus subsp. villosus
intro: Cymbopogon hirtus subsp. villosus, commonly known as Java citronella grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It is a type of essential oil-bearing plant that has been traditionally used for its health benefits, therapeutic actions, and unique bioactive constituents. The health benefits of Java citronella grass include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to prevent the growth of bacteria, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, such as citronellal, citronellol, and geraniol, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions, including sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-depressant effects.
